topic: 近三年具身机器人原子技能的发展及VLA成为主流的技术原因

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (high): ‘原子技能’在论文中并非统一标签，需同时覆盖 atomic skill、skill primitive、motor primitive、skill library、skill chaining、hierarchical policy、option/behavior tree 以及长时程任务分解。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-atomic-skill-direct
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"atomic skill" OR all:"atomic skills") AND (all:robot OR all:robotic)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 直接覆盖近年以 atomic skill 命名的机器人方法。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-skill-library
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"skill library" AND (all:"robot manipulation" OR all:"embodied control")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖可复用技能库的构建、检索、扩展与组合。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-skill-chaining
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"skill chaining" OR all:"skill composition") AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: 原子技能的技术价值取决于长时程组合与子任务依赖。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-motor-primitives
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"motor primitive" OR all:"behavior primitive" OR all:"action primitive") AND (all:manipulation OR all:robot)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖不使用 atomic skill 命名的相邻技术谱系。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-hierarchical-policy
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"hierarchical policy" AND (all:"robot manipulation" OR all:"long-horizon manipulation")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖高层技能选择与低层连续控制的分层方法。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-task-decomposition
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"task decomposition" OR all:"subtask decomposition") AND (all:robot OR all:embodied) AND all:manipulation
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖用语言模型或规划器将长任务拆成技能的路线。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-skill-segmentation
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"skill segmentation" OR all:"skill discovery") AND (all:robot OR all:manipulation)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖从演示中自动发现技能边界和潜变量的方法。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-continual-skills
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"continual skill learning" OR all:"lifelong robot learning") AND (all:manipulation OR all:control)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 检验技能库在持续扩展、遗忘与新技能接入上的优势和成本。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-skill-interface-limit
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"skill library" OR all:"skill primitive") AND (all:limitation OR all:failure OR all:scalability) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: 寻找固定技能语义、接口脆弱、组合误差和扩展成本等反方证据。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-skill-evaluation
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"skill composition" OR all:"hierarchical manipulation") AND (all:benchmark OR all:evaluation OR all:"real robot")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 寻找对长时程组合、真机闭环和失败恢复的评测证据。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-generalist-specialist
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:generalist AND all:specialist) AND (all:"robot policy" OR all:"robot manipulation")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 对照统一通才模型与专用技能专家的取舍。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-vla-atomic-hybrid
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:VLA OR all:"vision-language-action") AND (all:"atomic skill" OR all:"skill library" OR all:"mixture of experts")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 直接寻找 VLA 与技能库、专家路由结合的融合路线。

dynamic_suggestions.label: browser-atomic-skills
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs robot atomic skill library manipulation
dynamic_suggestions.why: 补充 arXiv API 对新命名和短语的召回。

dynamic_suggestions.label: browser-composable-skills
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs robot composable skills skill chaining long-horizon manipulation
dynamic_suggestions.why: 补充组合技能和长时程语彙。

calibration_notes: arxiv calibration (high): AtomicVLA 将 atomic skill library、skill-guided mixture-of-experts、continual skill acquisition 和 long-horizon planning 绑定在同一语汇中。
arxiv calibration (high): 论文使用 atomic skill library construction、dynamic update 与 VLA fine-tuning 词汇。
arxiv calibration (high): LRLL 使用 composable and generalizable skills、skill abstractor 与 lifelong robot library learning 词汇。
